verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets developers "use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform," and the probe confirms the documentation page exists. That gives a route to natural-language operation, but only through an external AI client, and the pitch is aimed at developers building integrations faster rather than at operating platform functions day to day. Missing for 10: evidence of which platform operations (onboarding, splits, payouts, balance accounts) the MCP tools cover, any native natural-language interface in the Dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
